mentions.name: Voice Notes Organizer
mentions.description: A Python Qt desktop app that organizes 20 years of personal voice notes, using Whisper with fallback online services to transcribe, summarize, and tag audio files. Its email-client-like UI has a tags pane, a center pane listing transcriptions and notes per audio file, and a right pane with detailed information about the selected file. The next step is serving the archive as a model context protocol server.
mentions.audience: 20 years of accumulated personal voice notes sat disorganized, including long-outdated reminders
mentions.source_excerpt: To organize them, I'm writing a Python Qt application with Claude Code. It started off as vibe coding, but I'm now developing it using processes very similar to those I would use when managing software teams. I've picked up a lot of good tips about that here on HN. I've got Whisper, and fallback online services, transcribing the audio and summarizing it and adding tags.
